{{Top|leg}}
'''Magnetic fasteners''' were components with a variety of uses. They used to secure cargo modules onto the deck of [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|Bantha-II cargo skiffs]] during transit. They were used in conjunction with cargo straps.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> Alongside [[locking clamp]]s, magnetic fasteners were used to connect the three pieces of a [[Defender sporting blaster pistol/Legends|Defender sporting blaster pistol]] together. The weapon could break into three pieces for easy concealment once a three-digit code was entered into an access panel located above the trigger.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
